spans.s: SV0135 कृशरा kṛśarā To prepare kṛśarā rice, gram, salt, ginger, asafetida are taken in appropriate quantity and boiled together to obtain. Also called as Khicadi/ Khara Pongal/ one pot preparation. It enhances the Agni (digestive fire) and alleviates Vataja and Pittaja disorders.
DG0124 कृष्ण वर्ग kṛṣṇa varga Group of 10 substances that colors mercury viz. Kadali(Musa paradisiacal), Karavellaka(Momordica charantia), etc.
AT0174 कृष्णं चातिस्रवत्यसृक् kṛṣṇaṁ cātisravatyasṛk Bite by a rabid animal results in copious flow of dark blood from the site of bite.
SR0223 कृष्णतारका kṛṣṇatārakā Iris. The colored contractile membrane suspended between lens and cornea
SR0222 कृष्णमण्डलम् kṛṣṇamaṇḍalam Iris. The colored contractile membrane suspended between lens and cornea
AF1047 कृष्णारुणकपाल वर्ण kṛṣṇāruṇakapāla varṇa Color of blackish red
